name: Meltdown
tagline: Melt into a glossy puddle like wax in the sun.
subject: the person
motion: {subject} starts to soften like warm wax. Their features droop and slide, colours running in glossy rivulets as the whole body slowly melts downward into a shiny swirling puddle on the ground. Surreal, smooth, satisfying motion. Static camera.
sound: slow gooey dripping, warm bubbling, and a satisfying final splat
author: Conjure
